items: OffsetModifier: Displaces path boundaries parallel to their normal vectors. Creates concentric contour rings, expanded badges, or shrunk wireframe skeletons. Features miter corner resolution, closed seam continuity, and automatic self-intersection untangling to prevent caustic loops / fishtail knots on acute insets.

Displaces path boundaries parallel to their normal vectors. Creates concentric contour rings, expanded badges, or shrunk wireframe skeletons. items: WobbleModifier: Geometric path modifier that converts sharp, rigid vector contours into imperfect, organic hand-drawn sketches. Features: - Biomechanical wrist/elbow bowing across straight segments. - Physiological motor tremor and roughness. - Automatic segment subdivision for long lines. - Corner overshoot & drafting crosses. - Dual-pass loose sketch strokes (Excalidraw / Rough.js aesthetic). - Animated cel line boil at configurable frame rates (e.g. 12 FPS). - Endpoint anchoring for node-link diagrams and graphs.

Geometric path modifier that converts sharp, rigid vector contours into imperfect, organic hand-drawn sketches. Features: - Biomechanical wrist/elbow bowing across straight segments. - Physiological motor tremor and roughness. - Automatic segment subdivision for long lines. - Corner overshoot & drafting crosses. - Dual-pass loose sketch strokes (Excalidraw / Rough.js aesthetic). - Animated cel line boil at configurable frame rates (e.g. 12 FPS). - Endpoint anchoring for node-link diagrams and graphs.

cells: Overall roughness / jitter amplitude (0.0 = perfectly rigid, 1.0 = normal sketch, 2.0+ = very rough). Displaces vertices and intermediate control points to simulate human motor tremor. Default: 0.15 [Source line 45](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/modifiers/path/WobbleModifier.ts#L45).

Biomechanical curvature / bowing factor (0.0 = no bowing, 1.0 = natural wrist arch). Simulates the anatomical arc produced by drawing with the wrist or elbow pivot. Default: 0.2 [Source line 52](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/modifiers/path/WobbleModifier.ts#L52).

Maximum segment length before subdividing long straight segments into multiple jittered sections. Prevents long lines from having only a single midpoint bow. Default: 0.8 [Source line 58](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/modifiers/path/WobbleModifier.ts#L58).

Corner overshoot factor (0.0 to 1.0) extending segment endpoints past intersections. Simulates rapid draftsman pen strokes that cross corners before lifting the pen. Default: 0.0 [Source line 65](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/modifiers/path/WobbleModifier.ts#L65).

When true on closed polygonal shapes, decomposes the closed contour into separate overshooting strokes that cross at corner intersections (draftsman / architectural style). Note: If using fill, keep this false so the shape interior remains a closed loop. Default: false [Source line 73](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/modifiers/path/WobbleModifier.ts#L73).

Number of sketch passes (1 for clean single contour, 2 for dual sketch, 3+ for loose multi-stroke drawing). Default: 1 [Source line 79](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/modifiers/path/WobbleModifier.ts#L79).

Whether to lock the absolute start and end coordinates of open paths. Keeps node connectors, circuit lines, and diagram arrows connected to their targets. Default: false [Source line 86](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/modifiers/path/WobbleModifier.ts#L86).
Time parameter for animated line boil or hand tremor. Default: 0.0 [Source line 98](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/modifiers/path/WobbleModifier.ts#L98).

Frame rate for animated line boil (e.g. 12 for traditional 12 FPS animation, 0 for continuous time). When > 0, quantizes the seed into discrete frames, simulating traditional cel animation jitter. Default: 12 [Source line 105](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/modifiers/path/WobbleModifier.ts#L105).

Whether the path forms a closed loop. When undefined, automatically detected from contour endpoints. When true, enforces closed-loop vertex matching, seamless stroke wrapping, and corner crossing. When false, treats the path as open (overshooting ends, anchored endpoints). [Source line 113](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/modifiers/path/WobbleModifier.ts#L113).

Pseudo-random bow side (+1 / -1) derived from the segment's endpoints and the frame seed. Shared by every pass, so the two sketch strokes of a line bend the same way and stay close together.
